target.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating video with xAI could configure provider request policy, such as custom headers or proxy settings, but xAI video generation requests ignored that policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The xAI video provider now sanitizes `cfg.models.providers.xai.request` and passes it into the existing provider HTTP resolver used by the create, poll, and download flow. The change is limited to request policy wiring and leaves generation parameters, polling semantics, idempotency headers, and media parsing unchanged.

## User Impact

Users who depend on configured provider transport policy can expect xAI video generation to honor those request settings. Default behavior is unchanged when no request policy is configured.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 19 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude --model claude-fable-5 --thinking high` reported no accepted/actionable findings.

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: local controlled request-policy proof

- Commit `523f5999e4` fixes the review gap by passing the resolved xAI request policy through video create, poll, and generated-video download. The poll/download stages now use guarded provider fetches when `allowPrivateNetwork` or a dispatcher/proxy policy is configured, while preserving the existing unconfigured fast path and bounded xAI JSON/media readers.
- Local focused proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 19 tests.
- The focused regression now asserts the configured header, explicit private-network opt-in, and dispatcher policy are visible on all three changed stages: create submit, status poll, and generated-video download.
- This is controlled local provider-path proof only. No live xAI API call was made and no real xAI account, proxy, or media generation was exercised.

## Proof

### 2026-07-12 exact-head local transport proof after CI-refresh update-branch

- Exact head tested after normal `gh pr update-branch`: `4ffb626175e89d694394ae655a69128245807ef0`.
- Scope: controlled local provider-path proof for xAI video generation create, poll, and generated-video download. This is not a live xAI API call.
- Commands run:

  ```bash
  git fetch fork alix/xai-request-policy-video-generation --no-tags
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git diff --check
  node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts
  ```

- Result: PASS. `git diff --check` passed; focused oxlint exited 0; Vitest passed 1 shard, 2 files, 20 tests in 22.02s total wall time. Vitest duration: 14.47s.
- Transcript excerpt:

  ```text
  HEAD is now at 4ffb626175 Merge branch 'main' into alix/xai-request-policy-video-generation
  4ffb626175e89d694394ae655a69128245807ef0
  Test Files  2 passed (2)
  Tests  20 passed (20)
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 22.02s
  ```

- Observation: `extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts` starts a local HTTP server and drives the real provider path through video create, poll, and generated-video download. The configured `X-Xai-Trace` header and Authorization header reach only xAI API-origin create/poll requests; the generated-video download request is a plain `GET` and does not include the custom header or Authorization. The companion unit test also asserts the download init remains headerless and the provider no longer overrides request-policy private-network opt-in with caller-level `allowPrivateNetwork:false`.
- Not tested: no live xAI account, real API key, external proxy/TLS route, real video generation job, or external provider endpoint was exercised.
